text:
I'll audit the corrected compiler and tests against the earlier exists+any and UNION findings, using the framework behavior already inspected.The exists-and-any correlation bypass is fixed, and the host UNION bypass is closed. No remaining concrete defect.

`any` and `all` now compile inside one outer `where` group whose boolean is `and` (`PredicateCompiler.php` lines 80–87). On a `whereHas` builder that already has the relation key, Eloquent keeps that `and`. The subquery is `key = parent AND (disjuncts)`, including a single-operand `any`, nested `exists`, and self-relations. The new expectations match the fixture: `exists('project', any(active = true))` is rows 1 and 3, both active values are rows 1–4 (row 5 stays out), and nested `members` stays on project 1. Root `any`, NULL complements, and branch grouping are unchanged apart from an extra set of parentheses.

The host UNION is handled before the predicate is attached (lines 28–53). A clone runs `applyScopes()`, then the compiler rejects a non-empty `unions` list (both `UNION` and `UNION ALL`) and a changed `from` or a top-level `or`. The predicate is added only after those checks. `setQuery` runs only on success, and `withoutGlobalScopes()` stops a later execution from adding a scope arm. A thrown compile leaves the original wheres and bindings in place. A normal scope is baked in once and stays applied on `count()`.

The other five paths are unchanged. The NULL handling, host WHERE preservation, identifier checks, atomic unsupported siblings, policy-versus-before partitions, and branch identity still hold.

VERDICT: GREEN
